text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Monday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- The World Bank is happy with Zimbabwe's planned second phase of economic reforms but will continue to withhold its financial support, including an already pledged Z$680 million, until the government addresses macro-economic problems, including a huge budget deficit, World Bank vice-president for Africa Calisto Madavo told the Herald.

- Zimbabwe's Harare City Council is seeking political intervention to delay a court order issued last October directing it to stop discharging sludge into the capital's main water source, Manyame river. The council says it needs more time to fine-tune an agreement with a company it has contracted to handle the project.
